value.rationale: Solves a concrete previously stated p³ supercongruence for every odd prime in a polynomial ring, a meaningful global uniform theorem beyond numerical examples and known modulo-p² results.

final_claim: For every odd prime p, the fourth-power Delannoy alternating polynomial sum satisfies Guo’s conjectured p^3 congruence coefficientwise in Z[X], with the explicit central-binomial right side.
limitations: p odd only; modulo p³ only, not p⁴ or composite prime powers.
